description.value: Stick In The Mud Roastorium is a specialty coffee roastery located in Sooke, BC, offering freshly roasted coffee beans, brewing equipment, and coffee education classes. The business operates both a physical roasting facility and an online shop selling single-origin coffees, grinders, brewers, and accessories. A touring cyclist rolling into Sooke's outskirts will find a craft-roaster destination rather than a typical café counter.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active coffee roastery business with online shop, classes, and wholesale offerings, consistent with OSM shop=coffee. No amenity-specific information (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, takeout drinks) is present in the scraped content — the site is primarily an e-commerce storefront. A name/spelling discrepancy exists: OSM records 'Stick In The Mud Roastorium' while the website title reads 'The Stick's Roastoreum' (different possessive form and alternate spelling of 'Roastoreum').
concerns: Name/spelling mismatch: OSM records 'Stick In The Mud Roastorium' but website header reads 'The Stick's Roastoreum' — different possessive form and alternate spelling ('Roastoreum' vs 'Roastorium'). May warrant OSM correction.

Business appears to be primarily a roastery and e-commerce operation; whether walk-in coffee service (espresso/drip drinks) is available at the physical location is not confirmed by the website content.
OSM tags wheelchair=no — physical access may be limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active coffee roastery with a live website, recent OSM check date (2025-07-20), and no closure indicators. A worthwhile stop for touring cyclists seeking specialty coffee and beans on the Sooke corridor.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website scraped content is dominated by the Shopify storefront shell and a very long currency-selector list, leaving little room for amenity or facility details. A direct visit or phone call would be needed to confirm on-site service, washrooms, and bike parking.
